summary: Tested new booking features including quote-based services with description/photo upload, pricing verification ($85 patio/driveway, $85+$45 dumpster), SMS opt-in, and email notifications. Fixed Resend API compatibility issue (resend.emails.send → resend.Emails.send). All features working correctly.

fixed.issue: Resend email API breaking change - resend.emails.send no longer exists
fixed.fix: Updated to use resend.Emails.send() with SendParams type (capital E)

passed_tests: Patio pricing shows $85 correctly in UI and API
Driveway pricing shows $85 correctly in UI and API
Home Power Washing (quote service) shows 'Quote' instead of price
Quote Request Details section appears only when quote service selected
Quote description textarea available and functional
Photo upload section available in Quote Request Details
Booking creation with quote service saves quote_description to database
Booking creation saves quote_photos to database
Email confirmation sent via Resend API after fix
Admin notification email sent successfully after fix
Admin dashboard displays all bookings correctly
Admin dashboard shows quote details for quote-based bookings
Calendar date selection works for booking flow
Full booking flow from service selection to confirmation works
action_items: Note: Customer email sending limited to verified domain in Resend sandbox - this is expected behavior with test API key. Production will need domain verification.
seed_data_creation: Created test bookings with quote services for verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resend email API was fixed - now uses capital E: resend.Emails.send() instead of resend.emails.send(). Customer emails to non-verified addresses fail in Resend sandbox mode which is expected. Admin notifications work correctly. All pricing displays correctly in both UI and API.
